# Tioga Technologies

> Solar power, STAMA smart locks and home automation across Nigeria. Lead-gen and product catalog site for residential and commercial customers in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Jos and beyond.

Tioga Technologies Ltd is an IoT infrastructure and embedded systems company building intelligent renewable energy and smart-home solutions for Africa. We sell pre-engineered solar packages (1KVA to 30KVA), biometric smart locks, and three tiers of home automation (Apex, Aura, Riviera).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of solar, smart lock and home automation offerings, with a personalized quote flow.
- [About](/about): Company mission, vision, three pillars of innovation, team and values.
- [Packages](/packages): Curated bundles for solar inverter systems, STAMA smart locks and home automation.
- [Catalog](/catalog): Full product catalog with 129+ items, filtering by category and budget.
- [LumiVolt](/lumivolt): Solar energy product line and waitlist for the LumiVolt mobile app.
- [VoltAi](/voltai): AI-driven home automation product line and waitlist for the VoltAi app.
- [Finance](/finance): Payment plans, installments and financing options for Nigerian customers.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, opening hours and physical office address in Jos, Plateau State.
- [Careers](/career): Open roles and how to apply.
